amos.4.p1.b1.text: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy, …

amos.4.p1.b3.text: “Behold, the days are coming when you will be taken away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.

amos.4.p1.b4.text: You will go out through broken walls, each one straight ahead of her, and you will be cast out toward Harmon,”

amos.4.p1.b5.text: “Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal!

amos.4.p1.b6.text: Offer leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings. For that is what you children of Israel love to do,”

amos.4.p2.b1.text: “I beset all your cities with cleanness of teeth … yet you did not return to Me,”

amos.4.p2.b2.text: One field received rain; another without rain withered. … yet you did not return to Me,”

amos.4.p2.b3.text: “I struck you with blight and mildew in your growing gardens and vineyards; the locust devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you did not return to Me,”

amos.4.p2.b4.text: “I sent plagues among you like those of Egypt; … along with your captured horses. … yet you did not return to Me,”

amos.4.p2.b5.text: and you were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze, yet you did not return to Me,”

amos.4.p2.b6.text: O Israel, … prepare to meet your God, O Israel!

amos.4.p2.b7.text: For behold, He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind and reveals His thoughts to man, who turns the dawn to darkness and strides on the heights of the earth— the LORD, the God of Hosts, is His name.”
